tips_en: Start with the distillation dynamics paper (Paper 2) for its rigorous controlled study challenging the assumption that on-policy learning is inherently superior—its surprising negative result will reframe how you think about the other two papers. Papers 2 and 3 are closely linked through the question of what actually drives capability transfer in post-training: Paper 2 isolates methodological factors (rollout policy, KL direction, learning rate) while Paper 3 probes a different axis—whether non-linguistic, structure-dense supervision (protein folding) can transfer to general reasoning. Paper 1 (OneStreamer) is more application-focused but complements the other two as a case study in designing multimodal LLM training for a challenging real-world inference regime.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读第二篇（蒸馏动力学论文），因为它通过严谨的对照实验挑战了"在策略学习必然优于离策略学习"这一常见假设，其出人意料的负向结论会帮助你重新审视另外两篇论文。第二篇和第三篇紧密相关，都聚焦于后训练阶段能力迁移的核心问题：第二篇隔离了方法学因素（rollout策略、KL方向、学习率）的影响，而第三篇则探索了不同维度——非语言的、结构密集的监督信号（蛋白质折叠）能否迁移到通用推理。第一篇（OneStreamer）更偏应用，但可作为另外两篇的补充案例，展示面向复杂真实推理场景的多模态大语言模型训练设计。
